findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "trendsfast_niche_trends" is 2813 chars, far longer than this server's median (558). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v3" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trendsfast_niche_trends, trendsfast_video_outlier, trendsfast_community_brief · Private data: trendsfast_niche_trends · Public sink: trendsfast_community_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trendsfast_niche_trends, trendsfast_video_outlier, trendsfast_community_brief · Private data: trendsfast_niche_trends · Public sink: trendsfast_community_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "trendsfast_niche_trends" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
